disruption_notes.text: A global IT outage (a faulty CrowdStrike update) disrupted U.S. airline operations from July 19, 2024; Delta's recovery took several days.
Hurricane Debby made landfall in Florida's Big Bend and brought prolonged heavy rain to Florida and the Southeast.
Hurricane Helene made landfall in Florida's Big Bend and moved inland across Georgia and the Carolinas.
Hurricane Milton crossed central Florida; Orlando and Tampa airports suspended operations.
